title: Reverse Linked List
description:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the new head of the reversed linked list.

If the input list is empty (`null` / `None`), return `null` / `None`.

Try to solve the problem iteratively in `O(1)` extra space.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 5000].
hints: Maintain two pointers, `prev` (initially null) and `curr` (initially head), as you walk through the list.
Before reversing `curr.next` to point to `prev`, save `curr.next` in a temporary variable so you do not lose the remainder of the list.
Once `curr` reaches null, `prev` points to the new head of the reversed list.

examples.explanation: Reversing a two-node list [1 -> 2] swaps their link direction to [2 -> 1].
